capabilities: Fetch completed tasks from the Things database on a configured interval
Backfill the entire historical Things Logbook on first sync
Write tasks into the daily note matching each task's completed date
Display each task's subtasks, tags, and areas
Configure section heading, sync frequency, and tag prefixing
extras: Warns that the initial sync may create or modify hundreds of files, recommends testing in a new vault and backing up data first. Includes donation and sponsorship links.
motivation: The author uses Things for task management but wants daily notes in Obsidian to be a holistic view of their day-to-day and a data source for their Second Brain.
problem: Obsidian daily notes don't include completed task history from external task managers like Things, so the daily note isn't a full record of the day.

relations.evidence: This plugin dumps completed tasks from Things into my daily notes

summary: Syncs completed tasks from the Things app's Logbook into the Obsidian daily note matching each task's completion date, on a set interval.
